name: Network Topology for Zabbix — Faceplate Widget
author: PlaNet Fox | Alexander Fox
description: Dashboard widget: the front panel of one switch — every port as a socket, coloured by link state or speed, with alias, traffic, PoE and LLDP neighbour on hover. Layouts 8+2 to 48+6, picked automatically from the discovered ports. Requires the main module (network_topology) — uses its network.topology.faceplate action.
